title: Total mass of the uniform law on a finite set
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, and let $\mu$ be the uniform probability law on the $n$-element set $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$, which assigns to each point equal weight. Then the total mass of $\mu$ is one; that is, $\mu(\{0,1,\dots,n-1\}) = 1$.
hypotheses_covered: n is a positive natural number
replaced: The uniform law on \texttt{Fin n} has total mass $1$.
